title: Instagram rolls out an AI video assistant for creators
slides: What if Instagram's AI edited your videos?
A new assistant for Instagram creators
But it only works for select creators
Your daily editing grind could shrink fast
Test one clip with it this week
thread_text:
1. Instagram's AI Editor

A new assistant for creators is being tested, but it only works for select accounts. Most people won't get access yet.

2. The Daily Editing Grind

Creators spend hours cutting clips, adding captions, and syncing audio. This tool claims to shrink that to minutes.

3. Who Actually Gets It

Access is limited to a small group of creators. Everyone else has to wait or find workarounds.

4. What This Means for You

If you're not in the test group, your editing time stays the same. The gap between early and late adopters could widen.

5. Test One Clip Now

Take a short video and run it through any AI editor you have access to. Does it save you time or create more work? Try it this week.

instagram.caption:
Instagram is testing an AI video assistant that edits clips for you, but it's locked to a small group of creators right now.

It handles the cutting, captions, and audio sync that normally eat your afternoon.

Everyone outside the test keeps editing the old way, by hand.

If you're not in the group, nothing changes for your workflow yet, and the gap between early and late access could widen.

Try one short clip in any AI editor you already have this week. Does it actually save time, or just add steps? 🎬
